page.notes: Printing: the running head "INDEX X." is centred above the columns. No page number is printed. A small mark ("¢" or similar) lies under the left column below "positum"; it may be a signature or a stray mark, and I did not transcribe it. The entry "Fraxinus arbor" has a small printed asterisk after "arbor". Doubtful readings: "ƒ" after "author" in Gedeon Ephod (symbol unclear); "effe-rantur" (word obscured); "pherica" in Hazaelis entry; "Hæmorrhoussæ" (ligature/letters unclear); "fit" in Hazaeli cur non entry and Hazael quæ mala entry; "dicti" in Galeni and Hæredipetæ entries (print may read differently). The letters G and H stand as section headings in the list. Several entries are abbreviated or hyphenated across lines as printed.
